long_biography.plain_text:
Pizza Hut franchising linked Jack L. Shelton to the restaurant chain that began in his home city of Wichita. He became involved during its expansion in the 1960s, and Tetra Management was operating dozens of Pizza Hut outlets across several states by the following decades. Shelton's business remained among the more substantial American restaurant franchise operations.

Polo has been a sustained part of Shelton's public life. He played competitively for decades, became involved with the Sarasota Polo Club after bringing his family to Florida, and chaired the United States Polo Association. His son Cash later developed Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers franchises in Florida, extending the family's involvement in restaurants through a separate business.
